figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. Biosynthetic models for the depside scaffold formation. Route A, depside skeleton consisting of aspergillusphenol A carboxylic acid and
orsellinic acid, formed by two PKSs, DepD and DepH; route B, asperdepside A formation, an aspergillusphenol A homodimer produced by DepD
and DepH; route C, proposed formation of lecanoric acid from two orsellinic acid units; and route D, novel pathway utilizing salicyl-CoA as a SAT-
domain starter unit, forming a depside skeleton incorporating an additional benzene (first report in this study).
